description: Recommend me something interesting to read this weekend.
I enjoy popular books with engaging stories, but I am open to anything.
I am looking for a light, comforting read before bed.
I used to enjoy slow books, but lately I want something fast-paced.
Surprise me! I do not have any strong preferences or deal-breakers.
I dislike Mystery.
Fantasy is fine, but please avoid Dark Fantasy and Isekai.
I am not in the mood for Comedy or Romcom. Science Fiction is okay.
I used to hate Romance, but now I enjoy it. I still cannot stand Psychological Thriller.
I don't dislike Historical Fiction; I just don't want Drama.
Books by Iris Vale are my favorite.
Please don't recommend anything written by Jeshine.
I used to enjoy Nora Vale, but now I prefer Rowan Vale.
I don't dislike Avery Lorne, but I don't want books by Mira Solen.
I want more books by Eleanor Voss. Please avoid Eleanor Vane.
I loved The Cartographer of Moonfall. I'd like something with a similar feel.
I liked The World Beneath the Blessing's atmosphere, but I do not want to read Definitely Not a Date.
The Silence Between Stars was exactly my kind of book, and I want more like it.
I enjoyed The Interview Advantage. I've heard of AI Without the Fog, but I have no opinion on it.
I want stories like The Last Light Before Morning, but I absolutely do not want to read How to Survive Being Seventeen.
I love books by Nora Vale, but I cannot stand Mystery.
I loved The Memory You Never Had, but I don't want books by Iris Vale anymore. I also dislike Comedy.
Please recommend books similar to The City the Maps Forgot, but avoid Dark Fantasy and Isekai.
I used to avoid Science Fiction, but now I enjoy it. I do not want books by Lucien Vale, and I still dislike Drama.
I want books like The City the Maps Forgot, and I prefer Rowan Vale. Please skip Comedy.
